test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Loud enough to be heard.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Audible"** means something that is loud enough to be heard. (सुनाई देने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's voice was barely audible over the noise of the students.
 
 
 
• **"Audit" **refers to an official inspection of an individual's or organization's accounts, typically by an independent body. (लेखा परीक्षा)
 
 
• **Example: **The company undergoes an audit every year to ensure financial accuracy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for "loud enough to be heard" is **'Audible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Audit **(लेखा परीक्षा): An official inspection of an individual's or organization's accounts.
 
 
• **Example:** The government has ordered an audit of the company's financial records.
 
 
 
• **Audacious **(साहसी): Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks.
 
 
• **Example: **Her audacious plan to climb the highest mountain was both risky and thrilling.
 
 
 
• **Audacity** (साहस): The willingness to take bold risks; impudence.
 
 
• **Example:** He had the audacity to question the manager's decision.
 
 

115:T998,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
